jobs.title: Lead Legal Operations Specialist
jobs.summary: We’re big believers in the power of IRL, so for most roles we ask Campers to work from their local Culture Amp office an average of 2 days a week to unlock connection, pace and cul…
jobs.description:
We’re big believers in the power of IRL, so for most roles we ask Campers to work from their local Culture Amp office an average of 2 days a week to unlock connection, pace and culture together.

Join us on our mission to make a better world of work.

Culture Amp is the world’s leading employee experience platform, revolutionizing how 25 million employees across more than 6,000 companies create a better world of work. Culture Amp empowers companies of all sizes and industries to transform employee engagement, drive performance management, and develop high-performing teams. Powered by people science and the most comprehensive employee dataset in the world, the most innovative companies including Canva, On, Asana, Dolby, McDonalds and Nasdaq depend on Culture Amp every day.

Culture Amp is backed by leading venture capital funds and has offices in the US, UK, Germany and Australia. Culture Amp has been recognized as one of the world’s top private cloud companies by Forbes and most innovative companies by Fast Company.

For more information visit cultureamp.com.

How you can help make a better world of work

Culture Amp is looking for a Legal Operations Lead to build the operating engine that helps our Legal team move quickly, consistently and at scale.

This is a new role with broad ownership across legal knowledge, intake, contract workflows, legal technology and operational reporting. You’ll turn established legal positions into clear, findable resources; improve the way requests enter and move through Legal; and help Sales, CX, Marketing and People teams get the right answers at the right time.

You’ll work closely with the General Counsel, lawyers, Sales, RevOps, Applications Support and other business partners. This is an operations and enablement role rather than a legal-advice role: you’ll handle routine requests within established guidance, escalate novel, high-risk or out-of-threshold matters to the appropriate lawyer, and fundamentally transform how legal support is delivered at Culture Amp to improve quality, speed and efficiency.

What you’ll do

Your aim is to improve the quality, speed and efficiency of legal support at Culture Amp, through better technology, tighter process and consistent, easy to use approaches and materials. You’ll do that by:

- Making Legal’s knowledge easy to find and use. Turn established positions, playbooks and templates into a single, trusted source for Sales, CX, Marketing and People teams, and for customers. Keep it current and drive adoption, so more questions are answered accurately without a lawyer.

- Designing how work flows through Legal. Own intake, triage and routing so routine requests are handled within established guidance. Anything novel, high-risk or out of threshold reaches the right lawyer early, with the context they need.

- Streamlining quote-to-contract. Partner with Sales, RevOps and Applications Support to make the path from quote to signature faster and more consistent. Keep templates, approvals and terms aligned with current guidance.

- Choosing and governing the right tools. Shape Legal’s technology roadmap with the General Counsel. Select, roll out and govern CLM, workflow and AI tools, with lawyer oversight built in where it matters.

- Using data to prioritise and show impact. Build simple reporting on volumes, cycle times and compliance, and use it to decide where to improve next and to demonstrate the return.

- Managing the cost and consistency of Legal’s wider support. Run the operational side of external counsel relationships, including routing, service levels and spend. Maintain lawyer-approved template libraries and self-serve guidance for People teams.

What you’ll bring

- 5–8 years’ experience in legal operations, contract management, deal desk, sales operations or a related function, ideally in a B2B SaaS or technology business.

- Hands-on experience configuring and administering a contract lifecycle management system such as DocuSign CLM, Ironclad or a similar platform, alongside e-signature and Salesforce integrations.

- Working knowledge of CPQ and quote-to-contract processes, ideally including DealHub or a comparable tool.

- Experience building and improving a legal, policy or contract knowledge base, playbook or FAQ library and driving adoption of it.

- Practical familiarity with SaaS commercial agreements and related concepts, including MSAs, order forms, DPAs, SLAs, NDAs, liability and data protection.

- A track record of reducing contract cycle time, request volume or operational friction, with metrics that demonstrate your impact.

- Experience evaluating, implementing or governing legal technology, workflow or AI solutions.

- Confidence working with stakeholders globally, particularly Australia, the UK, Germany and across US timezones

- A bachelor’s degree in legal studies, business, information systems or a related discipline.

A law degree or paralegal qualification is a plus, but admission as a lawyer is not required. Legal operations, Lean Six Sigma or project management credentials are also welcome but not essential.

Experience with Salesforce administration, DocuSign CLM or DealHub administration, SQL, Python, Confluence, Glean or generative AI tools will be valuable.

How you’ll work

- You’re a systems thinker. You see the full workflow and fix root causes rather than repeatedly treating symptoms.

- You have strong judgement. You know what can be answered from an established position, what needs more context and what must be escalated to a lawyer.

- You make knowledge usable. You turn expert judgement into clear, accessible content that people can find, trust and apply.

- You influence without formal authority. You can build adoption across Sales and other teams, not just configure a tool or publish a page.

- You’re commercially minded. You understand SaaS deal mechanics, thresholds and why contract speed matters to revenue.

- You’re data-driven. You use simple, meaningful reporting to set priorities and show impact.

- You’re an AI-forward builder. You use AI thoughtfully in your own work and understand where lawyer oversight is essential.

- You take ownership. You’re comfortable building from scratch, working independently and creating structure where there isn’t yet a dedicated legal operations function.

Working at Culture Amp

This role is based in our Chicago hub and requires working in the office at least three days each week. You’ll join a global Legal team and work cross-functionally with colleagues across the United States, APAC and EMEA.
For this role, the estimated base salary range is listed below. In addition to base salary, your compensation package will include additional components such as equity and benefits. For sales roles, your package may also include sales commission

The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual skills, capabilities and experience, objectively assessed during the interview process. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

We believe in fair & equitable pay at Culture Amp, and therefore, we build pay equity into all our programs in addition to conducting annual pay equity audits.

Base Salary Range (US)
$145,400—$176,000 USD

Perks & Benefits

At Culture Amp, our people are at the heart of our success. We offer competitive pay and a total rewards package designed to support you at work and in life. This includes:

- Equity through our Employee Share Option Program, so you can share in our long-term success

- Learning programs and coaching to help you thrive and grow

- Quarterly refresh days, an extended end-of-year break and a monthly allowance to support your wellbeing and lifestyle

- Inclusive parental leave from day one

- A MacBook and budget to set up your home workspace, enabling flexibility

- Five annual social impact days to to give back to causes that matter to you

- Medical insurance coverage for you and your family (Available for US & UK only)

Our rewards are designed to support different needs and life stages, recognising that what matters most can vary from person to person.

Research shows that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds may hesitate to apply if they don’t meet every requirement, but your unique experience matters. If you’re interested in joining us, we strongly encourage you to apply and help us build a more diverse and impactful team.

Accommodations & Data Privacy

If you require reasonable accommodations or adjustments due to a disability to complete the online application or to participate in the interview process, please contact accommodations@cultureamp.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

Culture Amp will retain your CV & personal information for a period of two years (four years for the US) from the date of your application process completion. Culture Amp may contact you in relation to future job opportunities during this time period. For further information please see our privacy policy here or contact privacy@cultureamp.com.

jobs.title: Litigation Paralegal
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within United States
jobs.summary: Somewhere out there, a subpoena is being served. It has twenty-seven document requests, a Kafkaseque set of instructions, and someone on the other end who would like it handled yes…
jobs.description:
Somewhere out there, a subpoena is being served. It has twenty-seven document requests, a Kafkaseque set of instructions, and someone on the other end who would like it handled yesterday. Next week, there will be more.

You can grind through that kind of volume by burning through headcount and leaving no stone unturned. Or you can meet it with creativity and judgment, stepping back to focus on what is actually needed and building systems so the next hundred meet the quality bar more easily than the last.

Litigation at Mercury is not about posturing or perfection. It’s about getting the important things right and knowing which things those are. As a Litigation Paralegal, you’ll join Mercury’s litigation team at a pivotal moment in the company’s story, drawing on your experience and judgment to help the company continue to innovate and scale as it builds a modern banking* experience trusted by more than 450,000 customers.

About the role

You’ll be a key member of our litigation team, supporting work across subpoenas, law enforcement requests, demand letters, discovery, and related workflows. You’ll partner closely with the Deputy General Counsel, Litigation & IP and Senior Litigation Paralegal but operate with a high degree of autonomy—owning high-volume processes, driving execution, and developing creative solutions that enable the team to amplify its impact even as the company grows and scales.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role where you’ll be trusted to figure out the right approach where there’s no playbook, manage competing priorities, and keep things moving—even when the path isn’t perfectly clear.

What you’ll be doing

- You’ll own core litigation-related workflows across the team, including managing responses to subpoenas and law enforcement requests, supporting discovery efforts, and coordinating litigation holds and document production.

- You’ll take the lead on high-volume intake and response processes, ensuring requests are tracked, deadlines are met, and responses are prepared efficiently and accurately.

- You’ll manage demand letter workflows end-to-end, including intake, drafting responses for attorney review, and driving matters through resolution.

- You’ll partner closely with attorneys to draft materials and move work forward independently, escalating more complex or higher-risk issues when needed.

- You’ll collaborate with Legal Operations to build and improve systems that support this work, including developing templates, playbooks, and more scalable processes for handling subpoenas, summons, and related matters.

- You’ll help oversee and improve automation and AI-assisted tooling in this space—ensuring outputs are accurate, handling exceptions, and identifying opportunities to expand automation over time.

- You’ll work cross-functionally with teams across the company to gather information and coordinate responses, and externally with vendors or outside counsel where needed.

Who you are

An exceptional paralegal with 4+ years of experience with a law firm or in-house legal team (or a combination of both). In addition, you’ll have:

- Meaningful experience supporting subpoenas, law enforcement requests, discovery, and other high-volume legal workflows

- Strong judgment and comfort taking ownership of work from start to finish

- Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills

- A proactive, low-ego approach and a willingness to jump in where needed

What we’d love to see

- A systems-oriented mindset—you’re always looking for ways to help us meet the quality bar more efficiently and consistently

- Creativity and a willingness to push beyond “the way things are normally done”

- Strong AI instincts and experience – can evaluate tools, deploy them responsibly, and drive adoption to make the team meaningfully faster

About the Legal team

Our Legal team exists to help Mercury build faster and better – responsibly.

We focus on thinking from first principles, creating valuable business outcomes, producing high-quality work, and doing it in a super-collaborative, growth-oriented team setting. We partner closely with teams across the company and believe that good legal judgment, applied thoughtfully, enables innovation rather than standing in its way.

Mercury values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Mercury are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities or special needs. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

#LI-JH1
Total Rewards
The total rewards package at Mercury includes base salary, equity (stock options/RSUs), and benefits.

Our salary and equity ranges are highly competitive within the SaaS and fintech industry and are updated regularly using the most reliable compensation survey data for our industry. New hire offers are made based on a candidate’s experience, expertise, geographic location, and internal pay equity relative to peers.

Our target new hire base salary ranges for this role are the following:

US employees in New York City, Los Angeles, Seattle, or the San Francisco Bay Area:
$128,600—$144,600 USD

US employees outside of New York City, Los Angeles, Seattle, or the San Francisco Bay Area:
$115,700—$130,100 USD

Headquarters: Egypt

URL: http://prospexcrm.xyz

Read This First

If you have not worked in a recruitment agency or sold recruitment services, stop here. This role is not for you.
We are hiring a pure hunter. This is not account management. This is not inbound. This is outbound sales, every day.

The Role

We are looking for a Business Development Specialist who knows recruitment sales inside out and is comfortable doing what most people avoid: cold calls, cold emails, and LinkedIn outreach at scale.
Your job is simple and measurable:
- Start conversations

- Qualify real hiring needs

- Book meetings

- Generate revenue opportunities

What You Will Do

- Cold call decision-makers daily (founders, CEOs, HR, Talent leads)

- Run high-volume cold email campaigns

- Prospect and sell via LinkedIn outreach

- Pitch recruitment services clearly, confidently, and without hesitation

- Handle objections without panicking

- Book qualified meetings that convert

- Keep CRM clean and updated

- Follow up relentlessly until you get a yes or a clear no

Non-Negotiable Requirements

- Previous experience in a recruitment agency (sales or BD)

- You have sold permanent, contract, RPO, or staffing services before

- Strong cold calling experience

- Proven outbound sales mindset

- Comfortable with rejection and pressure

- Fluent English (spoken and written)

- Self-driven. No hand-holding

Nice to Have
- Experience selling recruitment internationally

- Strong LinkedIn prospecting skills

- Experience with CRM and sales tools

jobs.summary: Tu as envie de travailler dans un environnement bienveillant qui avance vite ? 5ème fournisseur français en 10 ans, Octopus Energy est un fournisseur d’énergies renouvelables qui a…
jobs.description:
Tu as envie de travailler dans un environnement bienveillant qui avance vite ? 5ème fournisseur français en 10 ans, Octopus Energy est un fournisseur d’énergies renouvelables qui agit comme un véritable fer de lance pour la révolution électro tech.
 
Comment on fait ?  On ne peut pas révolutionner le monde en travaillant comme tout le monde On essaye de ne pas trop se prendre la tête, ici on évolue dans un environnement sans trop de process ni trop de règles. Le plus important, ce n’est pas seulement de suivre le mouvement, mais de le créer.

On ne veut pas créer des clones d’entreprise. On te veut toi, avec tes talents, tes perspectives et tes compétences uniques.

Cette fois ci, Octopus Energy France cherche son/sa futur.e Executive Assistant pour accompagner Céline, notre CEO, et le COMEX dans une phase de forte croissance.
Tu seras le véritable bras droit opérationnel de son bureau : ton rôle est de fluidifier son quotidien et de lui faire gagner de précieuses heures chaque semaine.

-
Piloter l’agenda de Céline et du COMEX de façon proactive : arbitrer, prioriser, protéger les temps de réflexion, anticiper les conflits.

-
Trouver des solutions créatives quand les rendez-vous ne rentrent plus : recomposer, déplacer, condenser, proposer des alternatives.

-
Faire le lien entre l’interne et l’externe : équipes, Groupe UK, partenaires, institutionnels (cabinets ministériels, etc.), dont les plans changent souvent à la dernière minute.

-
Rédiger des emails en français comme en anglais, avec un ton juste selon le destinataire (équipes, Groupe, institutionnels).

-
Organiser les déplacements (France et Europe), les événements et les temps forts (séminaires, ateliers, ....).

-
Traiter des sujets confidentiels (RH, financiers, stratégiques) avec une discrétion et une confidentialité absolues.

-
Tu as minimum 5 ans d’expérience en assistanat de direction (C-level ou COMEX), idéalement en scale-up ou en environnement international dynamique.

-
Tu es bilingue ou courant.e en français et en anglais : tes écrits sont clairs, soignés et sans faute, et tu sais adapter le ton (direct avec les équipes, plus formel avec l’extérieur). Tu échangeras au quotidien avec le Groupe.

-
Tu restes calme quand tout bouge en même temps, et tu sais jongler entre urgences internes et sollicitations externes.

-
Tu es créatif.ve et débrouillard.e : face à un agenda impossible, tu cherches une solution au lieu de remonter le problème.

-
Tu sais décider seul.e sur l’essentiel et reconnaître ce qui doit être remonté.

-
Tu es doté.e d'un excellent relationnel et d'assertivité : tu es à l’aise pour relancer des dirigeants, les challenger et dire « non » avec tact.

-
Éthique et discrétion irréprochables

-
Tu maîtrises Google Workspace et Slack, et tu prends vite en main de nouveaux outils.

- Contrat : CDD 5mois, temps plein (pouvant déboucher sur un CDI)

- Rythme & Lieu : Poste basé à Paris, 100 % au bureau pour être au cœur de l’action et au plus près de Céline et des équipes.

- Démarrage : ASAP.

jobs.summary: 🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.
jobs.description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not only about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo.

📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰£68,400-86,550 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits ✨

Our Customer Operations & Specialist Services teams⭐

We are recruiting for 4 opportunities across our Customer Operations and Specialist Services teams to join us as Senior Manager in Supplier Performance. We are recruiting for 2 roles, with 1 to join us in each of the following areas: VAIB (Vulnerability, Accessibility, Inclusivity and Bereavements) and Financial Health.

Outsourcing is key to enabling Monzo to meet its mission of making money work for everyone, as well as driving a cost efficient operation and delivering excellent customer service.

We are changing how we manage our relationships with our outsourcing partners by driving more responsibility and accountability through our Monzo domain leaders. We need a brilliant Seniors Managers to join this new oversight team, reporting directly to the Directors within each business area.

Partner management is moving right into the heart of our domains. You will be our eyes and ears on the ground, making sure our offshore outsource partners feel like a true extension of Monzo and not just an outsourced supplier. We ensure our partners are set up for success and deliver fantastic customer service.

🔑You’ll play a key role by...

You will act as the vital bridge between Monzo and our external partners to ensure they feel like a true extension of our team. You will drive both operational delivery and a brilliant customer experience. Working closely with our site leaders in South Africa, you will manage day to day service delivery while keeping a close eye on quality, customer satisfaction, and risk management. A key part of your role involves translating our strategic business goals into clear, actionable steps for the partner management team so they are fully equipped to succeed. You will support in domain forecasting and rolling out new processes to make sure they actually work on the floor. Ultimately, you will integrate our partner leaders into our regular performance reviews to foster a genuine one team mindset across the operation.

- Leading a dedicated oversight team: You will directly manage a Supplier Operations Partner who wil focus on Operational Delivery like SLAs, schedule adherence, Customer Experience, quality, and fixing the root causes of repeat contacts.

- Managing the partnership day to day: You will work directly with our outsourced partner Operations Managers to ensure the whole domain is delivering the service, customer satisfaction, quality and risk management we expect.

- Acting as the translation layer: You will turn our strategic business goals into practical, actionable steps for the outsouring management team. You will make sure they are equipped to succeed, rather than just telling them when they miss the mark.

- Tracking and managing performance: You will work alongside our partners to oversee all aspects of day to day service management, including handling risk events and stepping in to engage partners directly when performance drifts.

- Forecasting and planning: Alongside WFM you will raise and approve forecast requests and manage the end to end domain forecasting process for our partners.

- Owning change execution: You will handle the end to end definition and execution of change through our partners, ensuring any new processes or solutions are actually fit for purpose on the floor.

- Integrating the teams: You will support the domain Director to embed Teleperformance leaders into our existing domain performance review meetings, fostering a one team mindset.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

- You have proven track record of working closely with or managing global offshore partners and can manage to a customer experience, not just a commercial contract.

- You are deeply analytical mindset with the ability to anchor decisions in rigorous data, translating complex metrics into robust business cases that secure senior stakeholder buy in.

- You have a proven track record of leading through others and can influence, coach, and guide Managers who do not report directly to you.

- You are brilliant at translating complex business goals into simple steps for frontline teams.

- You zoom out when solving operational problems. Don’t just look at the operational team, always think about how your decisions impact the rest of the business.

Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰 £68,400-86,550 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.

📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps

- Recruiter call (25 minutes)

- Values & Behaviours Interview (60 minutes)

- Role Specific Interview (60 minutes)

This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.

#LI-REMOTE #LI-CB4

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage.

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Specialist
jobs.summary: Talkdesk competes in a market where the quality of execution separates companies that grow efficiently from those that spend more to get the same result.
jobs.description:
Talkdesk competes in a market where the quality of execution separates companies that grow efficiently from those that spend more to get the same result. Marketing Operations is where that execution lives. This role exists to ensure that every dollar of marketing spend, every campaign, every event, and every account-based program translates into pipeline with zero friction. That requires a system built for precision where the right prospect reaches the right person at the right time, consistently and by design.

You sit inside the Marketing team, with close partnerships across Sales and RevOps. The marketers running campaigns, events, and account-based programs are your primary stakeholders. When the system works, their work converts.

In practice, that means owning the full operational surface of marketing technology: administering and continuously improving the tools that make up our GTM stack, building and maintaining the integrations that keep data moving cleanly between systems, designing the orchestrations that automate account and contact engagement, ensuring the enrichment and data integrity standards that make every downstream decision reliable. This is an interdependent system, and this person keeps it running as a coherent, high-performing whole.

What You'll Own

- Account-Based Marketing Orchestration: Serve as the technical owner of our ABM orchestration layer. Translate signals from our intent platform into automated, sequenced actions across our marketing automation platform and CRM, working closely with campaign and field marketing teams to ensure the right programs reach the right accounts at the right moment. Getting this infrastructure right is one of the highest-impact contributions this role makes to the business.

- Marketing Technology Foundation: Own the day-to-day health of our martech systems and the workflows, API calls, integrations, and syncs that connect them to keep prospect data moving accurately through the funnel. When something breaks or underperforms, you diagnose it, fix it, and document the resolution so it does not recur.

- Agentic AI Workflow Engineering: Design and build automated workflows that use AI capabilities to evaluate qualitative signals, such as demo request notes, intent activity, and unstructured form inputs, alongside firmographic data to produce dynamic lead scores and routing decisions. You write the API calls, design the orchestration logic, test against edge cases, and iterate based on conversion outcomes. Experience shipping something to production is the bar.

- Enrichment and Insights: Build and manage the workflows that construct a complete, account-level intelligence profile from the moment a prospect engages. That means aggregating first-party behavioral signals, third-party intent data, firmographic context, and web research into a unified view that captures not just the individual contact but the broader buying committee: who across the account is engaging, with what content, and what their activity suggests about organizational priorities and pain points. That intelligence surfaces in the systems where sales and marketing work, so every follow-up is informed, relevant, and timed to the account's buying journey.

- System Documentation and Enablement: Every workflow you build or modify gets documented: field mapping dictionaries, AI orchestration logic, routing rule change logs. Beyond documentation, you actively invest in making the marketing team more self-sufficient, building self-service reporting and dashboards that allow marketers to check campaign performance, list quality, or lead status independently, and creating resources that allow colleagues to troubleshoot routine tasks and leverage AI tools without filing a request. An empowered marketing team operates with greater speed and confidence, and this role contributes meaningfully to that outcome.

Who You Are

You operate with a high degree of autonomy. You are embedded in the relevant standups, attentive to system performance, and typically ahead of issues before they surface as escalations. Your manager will set context and priorities; the execution is yours to own.

You are invested in the success of the Marketing team. You understand that the campaigns, events, and programs your colleagues execute are only as effective as the systems that support them. Leads from a field event that go unrouted, an ABM sequence that executes against incomplete data, or a high-intent inbound request that experiences significant delay before reaching an SDR all represent measurable pipeline impact. You approach your work with that accountability in mind.

You are technically strong and collaborative by nature. Marketers, Sales and RevOps are close partners. You understand their workflows well enough to anticipate where system gaps will affect their work, and communicate clearly when something is broken, when it is fixed, and why. Strong cross-functional relationships are central to this role.

You see the work through to completion. You build, test, document, and close the loop. When something you own regresses, you identify it first.

What We're Looking For

Required

- 3 to 5 years in B2B SaaS Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, or a systems-adjacent role

- Hands-on marketing automation and CRM administration, including configuring and maintaining MAP-to-CRM syncs

- Demonstrated ability to build and deploy an automated workflow that calls external APIs, whether webhooks, REST APIs, or LLM endpoints, in a production environment

- Native fluency in B2B funnel mechanics: MQL definitions, lifecycle stage transitions, opportunity lifecycles, and attribution models

- Experience coaching or enabling non-technical stakeholders on new tools, AI workflows, or self-service reporting

Strong Signal

- Hands-on administrative experience with intent data platforms, routing engines, and ABM orchestration

- Prior experience building LLM-powered workflows for lead scoring, routing, or qualification

- Comfort reading and writing JSON, working with REST APIs, and debugging integration errors independently

How We'll Measure Success

The through-line across all of it is pipeline efficiency: more of the right prospects converting into pipeline from the programs already running, with less manual intervention and less fallout.

30 days: Full audit of marketing automation-to-CRM field mapping is complete, ownership of inbound routing rules is established, and current ABM workflow patterns are mapped to identify key automation opportunities.

60 days: First agentic AI workflow is deployed to staging or production. At least one major ABM orchestration sequence that previously required manual steps is automated. An initial self-service enablement resource or dashboard is delivered to the marketing team.

90 days and beyond: Lead sync exception rate is at target with a monitoring process that catches regressions before Sales does. ABM orchestration operates as a reliable service layer that campaign and field marketers can brief and trust to execute. Marketing colleagues actively leverage self-service tools and AI workflows independently.

Application Question

Required with your resume (200 words max):

A high-intent prospect submits a demo request but never reaches the assigned SDR in the CRM. Walk us through your exact diagnostic process: which logs you check first, how you trace the break across the marketing automation-to-CRM sync and inbound routing rules, how you validate the fix, and how you would design an agentic step to evaluate the prospect's form submission notes for priority routing.

Pay Range (OTE Pay): $86,000 - $120,000

Other Types of Pay: Based on level and role the employee may be eligible for long term incentives in the form of equity and short term incentives of either bonus or commission.

Health Insurance: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability Insurance, Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

Retirement Benefits: 401(k) plan

Paid Time Off: Talkdesk offers an uncapped paid time off program for exempt employees and an accrual-based program for non-exempt employees; both are subject to manager approval and consistent with business needs.

Paid Holidays: Talkdesk offers 14 paid holidays each year.

Paid Sick Leave: Exempt employees have uncapped paid time off and non-exempt sick leave follows accrual standards; both are subject to manager approval and consistent with business needs.

Method of Application: Apply online.

Application Window: The application window is expected to close at least 10 days from the posting date. The application was posted on 09/25/2026.

Benefits and perks listed above may vary based on the nature of your employment with Talkdesk.

All questions or concerns about this posting should be directed to the Talent team at Talent@talkdesk.com.
Talkdesk is pioneering a new era of Customer Experience Automation (CXA), redefining how the world’s most admired brands interact with their customers through AI. Our global team of courageous innovators is customer-obsessed, building AI-first solutions that put empathy, trust, and transparency at the center of every interaction. We foster an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives drive our success and every voice belongs. Combining the stability of a global leader with the agility of a disruptor, Talkdeskers are empowered with the autonomy to drive meaningful impact, while giving back to the communities and environment around us.

Talkdesk has been recognized as a Leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) and in the G2 Overall Grid® Reports for AI Agents and Contact Center. With seven consecutive years on the Forbes Cloud 100 and multiple AI Breakthrough awards, there has never been a more exciting time to join us as we shape the future of customer experience automation!

Work Environment and Physical Requirements:

Primarily office-environment work, extended periods of sitting or standing, computer-based work. Limited lifting, and equipment usage limited to computer-related equipment (keyboards, mouse, etc.)

The Talkdesk story hinges on empathy and acceptance. It is the shared goal among all Talkdeskers to empower a new kind of customer hero through our innovative software solution, and we firmly believe that the best path to success for our mission is inclusivity, diversity, and genuine acceptance. To that end, we will hire, promote, work along, cheer for, bond with, and warmly welcome into the Talkdesk family all persons without regard to ethnic and racial identity, indigenous heritage, national origin, religion, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.description:
Job Summary:
The Clinical Training Support Specialist plays a vital supportive role in designing and managing high-quality onboarding and clinical training across the entire Included Health Clinical Practice/Clinical Org practice—spanning Virtual Care, Population Health, and emerging service lines. Your primary focus will be on instructional design, transforming complex clinical policies and workflows into engaging digital learning content (eLearning modules, video simulations, and interactive scenarios). As a core pillar of the training team, you will manage our Learning Management System (LMS), collect and analyze training data, and act as a dedicated learner assistant to ensure seamless educational rollouts.
While your primary focus is content creation and support, you will also assist in cross-covering live training sessions for various onboarding cohorts. You will be an AI-forward builder who uses AI tools and other technologies to accelerate content development, reduce manual work, and embed just-in-time support into the clinician experience. This role is ideal for an instructional design professional who excels at behind-the-scenes content creation and LMS administration, yet remains flexible enough to step into the room to support live learners and educators when needed.
Responsibilities:
1. Content Creation, Execution & Maintenance
Prepare, use, and update existing training materials (slides, facilitator guides, job aids, scenarios, and exercises) created and/or approved by the Senior Clinical Training Specialists, Manager, and CKE team.
Surface content gaps or inconsistencies you see during training (e.g., slide doesn’t match CRC, workflow screenshot is outdated) so they can be prioritized for formal updates.
Use LMS and training tools at a proficient user level (launching sessions, tracking completions, pulling basic reports).
Design instruction based on clinical workflows in collaboration with CKE team and stakeholders.
2. Cross-Service Line Clinical Facilitation
Deliver live virtual training (group sessions, small-group breakouts, and 1:1 coaching) for clinical new hires and tenured clinicians across Virtual Care and Population Health service lines.
Facilitate a mix of foundational, workflow, and application-based sessions (e.g., documentation practice, care plan workflows, triage scenarios, navigation workflows) using adult learning best practices.
Support or co-lead clinical simulations, mock calls, and role plays, observing performance, giving clear, behavior-based feedback, and escalating clinical safety concerns appropriately.
Flex into different service lines as hiring volume, redesign work, or audit findings shift the training portfolio — maintaining sufficient cross-training to be safe and effective wherever you are deployed.
3. Cohort Support & Learner Coaching
Partner with the Senior Clinical Training Specialists to execute the day-to-day plan for new hire cohorts (agenda, timing, logistics, handoff points).
Monitor learner engagement, participation, and performance during sessions; identify individuals who need additional support and provide targeted coaching or remediation as directed by the Senior(s) and Manager.
Use rubrics, checklists, and competency tools to document learner progress and escalate concerns regarding readiness for independent work.
Contribute to a psychologically safe learning environment where clinicians can practice, make mistakes, and receive direct but supportive feedback.
4. Data, Feedback, and Continuous Improvement
Capture and share learner feedback, questions, and pain points from the classroom in a structured way to inform curriculum improvements and service-line decisions.
Create and monitor formal metrics for learning and successful application of skills.
Use available data (e.g., knowledge checks, simulation scores, survey results) to describe trends you’re seeing in learner performance and experience, and to validate where additional coaching or clarification is needed.
Participate in course audits, pilots, and retrospectives, giving concrete recommendations on pacing, activities, and scaffolding from the trainer perspective.
Champion a “Spirit of Inquiry” by modeling curiosity, evidence-based practice, and openness to feedback in your own facilitation.
5. Surge Support & Operational Flex
During surge periods or large cohorts, act as co-facilitator/producer, managing breakout rooms, chat questions, tech issues, and basic operational workflows so Senior Trainers can focus on high-complexity clinical teaching and stakeholder interactions.
Lead or co-lead baseline operational sessions (e.g., navigation of training environments, structured documentation practice, non-clinical workflows) when appropriate to free up Senior bandwidth.
Adhere to and reinforce capacity rules and surge protocols defined by the Manager and Senior Trainers (e.g., ratio rules, blackout dates, backup facilitator coverage).
Required Qualifications:
Experience:
2+ years of experience in formal clinical/healthcare training, precepting, clinical education, or adult learning.
Specifically, instructional design, LMS management, data collection, learner assistance, etc.
Facilitation & communication:
Strong virtual facilitation skills (Zoom/Google Meet or similar).
Demonstrated ability to explain complex clinical workflows in clear, practical language and to give direct, respectful feedback to peers or learners.
Collaboration & adaptability:
Comfortable flexing between service lines, cohorts, and workstreams as priorities change.
Proven ability to build trust with clinicians, people leaders, and cross-functional partners.
Preferred Qualifications:
Clinical credentials: RN/BSN or other equivalent clinical degree with an active, unrestricted license (or able to reactivate an expired license, if applicable).
Experience in one or more of Included Health’s core clinical environments (e.g., Urgent Care, Behavioral Health, Virtual Primary Care, Care Management, Triage, Navigation).
Familiarity with Athena or similar EHR.
Exposure to instructional design principles (e.g., ADDIE, flipped classroom, scaffolding).
Experience working in a fast-paced, high-change or virtual-first environment, comfortable iterating based on feedback and data.
 
The salary range for this full time position is $67,850.00 - $94,000.00 + equity + benefits. This posted range reflects the portion of our internal pay band that is currently funded for new hires in this role across our standard labor markets (Zones A–C). 
For context, these markets include Zone A (e.g., Phoenix AZ, San Antonio TX, Columbus OH, Charlotte NC), Zone B (e.g., Chicago IL, Denver CO, San Diego CA, Houston TX), and Zone C (e.g., Los Angeles CA, Seattle WA, Washington, D.C., Boston MA). At this time, we are not budgeting for hires in higher-cost Zone D markets (e.g., San Francisco Bay Area CA, New York City NY, San Jose CA) for this role. Within this range, individual pay is determined by work location, skills, experience, and internal equity. We use structured pay bands and geographic zones based on cost of labor to keep pay fair and consistent.
 
Benefits & Perks:
 
In addition to receiving a great compensation package, the compensation package may include, depending on the role, the following and more:
-Remote-first culture
-401(k) savings plan through Fidelity

About the brand
Haven manages cabins and mountain homes in the Great Smoky Mountains and around Knoxville, Tennessee. Steep driveways, hot tubs, wood stoves, and a season that swings from quiet weeks to a full house every weekend. It is a market where property care is guest experience: a cold hot tub is a ruined anniversary, and a turnover that runs late is a family waiting in the driveway.
The role
You are the person who makes sure every cabin is guest-ready before the next family arrives. You are the main communication point between Haven operations and our Tendwell cleaning teams. Your day starts with the departures, arrivals and cleaning schedule, and from there you follow up with cleaners on progress and ETAs, clear whatever is blocking a turn, coordinate re-cleans and supply fixes, and confirm each home is ready before a same-day check-in.
When a guest checks out late, you work out what it does to the cleaning schedule and tell operations what timing is realistic. It is a role for someone who is highly responsive and calm under same-day pressure. Asking for an update is not the same as getting the home ready. If a turn is yours, you own it until it is confirmed complete.
Where you sit
You sit in Housekeeping & Field Ops and work every day with Tendwell cleaners and Haven’s operations team. This is not a role where you are handed a queue and left alone.
This role is remote and based in LATAM, covering U.S. Eastern Time working hours. Because Stayd runs shared systems across every brand, a process you improve here tends to end up running in six other markets, which is the closest thing we have to a promotion path.
What you’ll own
- Follow up with cleaners on turn status, ETAs and anything blocking completion.
- Coordinate re-cleans, missed items and supply fixes.
- Confirm guest-ready status for every same-day arrival.
- Assess how late checkouts affect the cleaning schedule and communicate realistic timelines.
- Relay delays, updates and completion details to Haven operations, escalating urgent issues promptly.
- Collect and post completion evidence, including photos where required.
- Keep communication with cleaners, internal teams and stakeholders clear and organized.
- Spot recurring issues and help improve cleaning workflows and SOPs.
What you bring
- Experience in short-term rentals, hospitality, housekeeping coordination or field operations is strongly preferred.
- High responsiveness and the ability to manage urgent, same-day issues without losing track of the rest.
- Strong attention to detail.
- Comfort following up with field teams, again and again, until the job is done.
- Clear written English for communication with cleaners and the operations team.
- Availability to work U.S. Eastern Time hours, plus occasional weekend coverage.
- Reliable internet and a quiet place to work.
Compensation & Benefits
- $1,200–$1,500/month, depending on experience.
- Fully remote, with flexible scheduling within U.S. time-zone overlap.
- A path to grow into a broader operations leadership role across the portfolio.
How to apply
Apply here in about four minutes on a phone. There are a handful of questions written to find out what you can actually do, a resume, and a short voice introduction for roles where spoken English is part of the work. There is no cover letter and there is no portal account to create.
You can listen to your recording and try again as many times as you need. If a microphone, privacy, or accessibility issue prevents recording, request another screening option and a recruiter will see it.
Every single applicant hears back from us, including a no. If we are not moving forward we will tell you, and we will tell you why. If you need an accommodation to complete this application, email careers@stayd.co. Asking never counts against you.
By applying, you agree that Stayd may contact you about your application by email and WhatsApp. Reply STOP at any time to opt out.

For over 10 years, Magic has connected top remote talent with fast-growing businesses — backed by Y Combinator and Sequoia Capital, with thousands of remote workers worldwide.

This is a post-sale, account-first role. You'll carry a book of client-assistant pairings and be accountable for how well each one works — from day one of onboarding through every milestone after. Inbound requests will come in, but fielding requests isn't the core of the job. The core is knowing your accounts well enough that you can spot what's about to go wrong before it does, get on a call, and fix it.

Shift: Monday–Friday, 10 PM–7 AM PHT. Training runs 4 weeks across two phases — Product & Skills (shadowing, live-call listening) then Immersion (live tickets and onboarding under supervision, KPIs measured from day one). Zero absences during training, documented medical emergencies only, 80%+ required on daily assessments and mock calls to continue.

-
Manage a portfolio of client accounts — track the health of each pairing, flag risks early, and keep every relationship on track

-
Lead onboarding sessions, 30-day account reviews, and recurring check-ins that keep clients and their assistants aligned

-
Advocate for assistants internally — coaching conversations, feedback loops, and surfacing what they need to leadership

-
Own retention conversations — identify accounts at risk and lead win-back efforts before the client decides to leave

-
Handle 30+ inbound account requests daily with fast, personalized responses that reflect actual knowledge of that account

-
Maintain clean, detailed HubSpot records for every client interaction — useful to anyone who touches the account after you

-
Coordinate across Operations, Finance, and Engineering when an account issue goes beyond your direct scope

- 3+ years of client-facing experience in account management, account support, or B2B customer success — US accounts strongly preferred

- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple active client accounts simultaneously without losing thread or detail

- Fluent written and verbal English — equally sharp in a written account update and a live escalation call

- Reliable night-shift availability (10 PM–7 AM PHT) with documented history of night-shift work

- CRM proficiency, HubSpot preferred

- Proactive by default — you identify account risks and act on them before anyone has to ask

After 90 days, your accounts run smoothly not because nothing went wrong — but because you caught the problems early and handled them. You know your client portfolio without having to look everything up. You're as comfortable on a direct call with a frustrated client as you are writing a clear, concise account note at 3 AM. You've worked night shift before, and you know how to pace yourself through a shift that gets busy fast when US business hours kick in.

You can talk to anyone, on any team, about anything, because we respect each other's time and actually like working together. Y Combinator and Sequoia-backed, thousands of remote workers strong, and growing.

Take ownership and follow through without supervision.

Enjoy organizing, tracking, and closing the loop.

Understand that one missed interview affects both a client and a candidate.

Why Join

Directly improve client satisfaction and candidate experience.

Work in a structured team where reliability is recognized.

jobs.title: Workplace Operations Coordinator
jobs.summary: Chi siamo Il sistema energetico funziona meglio quando le persone possono farne parte.
jobs.description:
Chi siamo 
Il sistema energetico funziona meglio quando le persone possono farne parte. In Octopus Energy lo facciamo già ogni giorno: rendiamo l'energia più equa e accessibile grazie alla tecnologia.
Presenti in Italia dal 2022, siamo partiti da Ascoli Piceno, dove abbiamo la nostra sede. Oggi abbiamo superato un milione di utenze, con un team di oltre 300 persone tra Ascoli Piceno, Milano e Roma, e più di 250 milioni di euro investiti nel Paese. Una crescita nata da un modo diverso di fare energia: più semplice, più umano, più tecnologico.
 
Come lavoriamo 
Non siamo una compagnia tradizionale e non vogliamo diventarlo. Non ci piacciono la burocrazia, le procedure inutili o i reparti che si scaricano i problemi a vicenda. Quando un cliente ha bisogno di aiuto, vogliamo che trovi persone capaci di ascoltare, prendersi la responsabilità e risolvere.
Questo approccio ci ha portati a essere valutati 4,9/5 su Trustpilot, a vincere la classifica Altroconsumo e a ricevere il premio "Miglior Servizio Clienti" del Corriere della Sera.
 
La tecnologia al servizio di tutti
Qui la tecnologia non è riservata a pochi esperti: è uno strumento che aiuta tutti a lavorare meglio. Non serve essere un mago del computer, ma serve curiosità. Usiamo dati, automazione e intelligenza artificiale per togliere complessità, capire meglio i problemi e dedicare più energia a ciò che conta: migliorare il modo in cui le persone vivono l’energia.
 
Cosa troverai in Octopus
Octopus è un posto per chi vuole portare energia e buon senso. I problemi non arrivano sempre ordinati, le risposte non sono sempre già scritte e spesso c’è da costruire mentre si corre. Ma non sarai solo: lavorerai con persone curiose, generose e concrete, che si aiutano a vicenda e vogliono lasciare le cose meglio di come le hanno trovate. Stiamo già migliorando il modo in cui l’energia funziona per le persone: se vuoi prenderti responsabilità e contribuire a questo cambiamento, qui il tuo lavoro può avere un impatto vero.
 

Gli spazi in cui lavoriamo contano: sono il posto dove le persone si incontrano, si aiutano e costruiscono Octopus ogni giorno. E in Italia stiamo crescendo in fretta, tra Ascoli Piceno, Milano e Roma.

Cerchiamo una persona che si prenda la responsabilità di tutti i nostri spazi fisici, con una visione d’insieme: dove abbiamo sede, a quali condizioni, con quali fornitori, se rispettiamo le norme e come cresceremo. La gestione quotidiana degli uffici è ad oggi affidata agli Office Manager, e tu li guidi e li metti nelle condizioni di lavorare bene, senza sostituirti a loro.

Non cerchiamo un facility manager e nemmeno qualcuno che aggiunga procedure. Cerchiamo una persona che tratti i nostri spazi come se fossero casa sua: con cura, con attenzione a come si spendono i soldi, e con la libertà di decidere da sola ciò che serve, senza aspettare che qualcuno lo chieda. Qualcuno con iniziativa, buonsenso e un approccio commerciale, che renda i nostri spazi semplici da vivere e sostenibili nel tempo.

-
Guida degli Office Manager: dare indirizzo e supporto agli Office Manager delle nostre sedi, definire insieme standard comuni, e fare da riferimento quando un problema supera l’operatività quotidiana.

-
Strategia degli spazi e nuove sedi: guidare la ricerca di nuove sedi e coordinare allestimenti, trasferimenti e apertura dei nuovi spazi, dal progetto alla consegna, definendo come i nostri uffici devono crescere insieme all’azienda.

-
Contratti di locazione e proprietà: gestire i contratti esistenti, le scadenze e i rinnovi, e condurre le trattative su nuovi immobili e condizioni.

-
Contratti con i fornitori: negoziare, rivedere e armonizzare i contratti quadro (pulizie, manutenzioni, utenze, sicurezza, servizi generali), cercando efficienze e sinergie tra le sedi dove ha senso.

-
Spedizioni e corrieri: governare il processo di spedizioni e posta e gestire il rapporto con il fornitore di corriere, definendo regole, livelli di servizio e costi.

-
Presidio degli asset aziendali: assicurare che gli asset di Octopus, come il magazzino e i mezzi aziendali, siano gestiti con cura (inventario, accessi, sicurezza, assicurazioni).

-
Lavorare con tutta l’azienda: collaborare con i colleghi e i responsabili delle diverse aree per far funzionare gli spazi in modo coordinato.

-
Portare avanti la missione di Octopus: fare tua la missione e l’indirizzo dell’azienda, tradurli nelle scelte sugli spazi e portarli avanti con convinzione, facendoli rispettare. Non tutto avrà una procedura già pronta: ti muovi anche dove le cose non sono definite e trovi la soluzione sensata

-
Orientamento alla soluzione e concretezza: non hai paura di metterti in gioco in prima persona, ti piace l'operatività e trovi soddisfazione nel risolvere i problemi sul campo in modo rapido e pratico.

-
Esperienza: hai avuto esperienza in contesti operativi, di accoglienza, retail, hospitality o supporto organizzativo, ma soprattutto hai una gran voglia di imparare e crescere in un contesto veloce.

-
Energia e spirito di iniziativa: sei una persona dinamica, solare e positiva. Se c'è da spostare uno scatolone, riordinare una sala o gestire un'emergenza dell'ultimo minuto, sei il* prim* a dare una mano.

-
Precisione e doti organizzative: anche nel caos saprai prioritizzare le urgenze e tenere tutto sotto controllo senza perdere il filo.

-
Condivisione della missione: senti tua la direzione dell’azienda, la traduci in decisioni concrete e la porti avanti con convinzione, facendola rispettare.

-
Comfort con il non strutturato: ti trovi a tuo agio dove non tutto è definito da procedure e sai costruire l’ordine man mano.

In Octopus fare bene il tuo lavoro è naturale: trovi le condizioni giuste per esprimerti al meglio, perché i tuoi obiettivi, quelli dei colleghi e quelli dell’azienda sono perfettamente allineati.

Lavorerai con persone curiose, brillanti e concrete, che hanno voglia di fare bene e migliorare davvero le cose.

Lavorerai per un’azienda che le persone scelgono perché si fidano: abbiamo un servizio clienti valutato 4,9/5 su Trustpilot e premiato da Altroconsumo e dal Corriere della Sera.

Farai parte di una realtà concreta, veloce e poco burocratica, dove contano i risultati, il modo in cui li raggiungiamo e l’impatto che creiamo per i clienti.

- Octopus Energy è un luogo in cui le persone hanno spazio per imparare, prendersi responsabilità e fare davvero la differenza.

-
Equity Options Scheme: in Octopus puoi avere accesso a opzioni su azioni del Gruppo. In pratica, puoi possedere la tua parte di Octopus Energy e partecipare al valore che costruiamo insieme.

-
Focus sul tuo benessere: ti supportiamo con vantaggi concreti come i buoni pasto e un accesso gratuito a sessioni di benessere psicologico.

-
Cultura: ogni settimana, il venerdì, ci riuniamo tutti per gli aggiornamenti aziendali e un brindisi. Lo chiamiamo Family Dinner.

-
Sede: Ancarano (TE)

-
Ore: Tempo pieno

-
Presenza in ufficio: Si

Da 37K

La normativa ci chiede di indicare la retribuzione di partenza, e ci sembra giusto farlo. Allo stesso tempo, non amiamo la burocrazia né crediamo che il valore di una persona possa essere racchiuso in una tabella. Preferiamo usare il buonsenso: l'eventuale offerta sarà costruita sulla base delle valutazioni fatte durante il percorso di selezione, tenendo conto di esperienza, competenze, luogo di lavoro e allineamento con il ruolo e con ciò che stiamo costruendo.

jobs.title: Customer Service Representative
jobs.summary: Work From Home. Pick Your Schedule. Get Paid Weekly. Welcome to ShyftOff! Tired of traditional jobs that expect you to build your life around a fixed schedule? At ShyftOff, we beli…
jobs.description:
Work From Home. Pick Your Schedule. Get Paid Weekly. Welcome to ShyftOff!
Tired of traditional jobs that expect you to build your life around a fixed schedule? At ShyftOff, we believe work should fit into your life, not the other way around!
We're changing the way customer service works by connecting independent professionals with exciting opportunities to support established businesses, all from the comfort of home.
Whether you're looking to earn extra income, take greater control of your schedule, or explore a flexible remote opportunity, ShyftOff gives you the freedom to work differently.
Why Choose ShyftOff?
No commute. No traditional fixed schedule. More flexibility. More control.
- 100% Remote: Forget the commute! Work from the comfort of your own home.
- Weekly Pay: Get paid every week for eligible completed work.
- You Make Your Schedule: Choose available shifts that fit your lifestyle. Work when opportunities align with your availability.
- Earn $14-$20 Per Hour: Competitive campaign pay with opportunities to increase your earnings based on program and eligibility.
Important: Applications will only be considered if you apply on the ShyftOff website at https://www.shyftoff.com/agents
The Role
As an independent agent, you take inbound calls for ShyftOff client programs and help customers answer questions, resolve issues, and get what they need. After you join, you choose which programs to apply for based on your qualifications and availability.
One of our newest programs include:
Financial Services Program — $15–$20 per hour plus incentives + $300 certification bonus
Help cardholders manage their money with confidence. You'll take inbound calls from people who rely on their banking cards for everyday life: activating a new card, replacing a lost one, sorting out a disputed charge, or getting a time-sensitive payment through. This is credentialed financial services work on an established account, built for people who want to meet a real bar and stick around.
What you'll do:
- Handle inbound calls on card activation, replacements, lost or stolen cards, balances, and account questions
- Help customers with payments, transfers, and disputes, accurately and securely
- Verify customer identity and follow strict security and compliance protocols on every call
- Spot and help resolve potential fraud with composure
- Document every interaction accurately in the account's systems
Who you'll talk to: cardholders and their benefits managers, often at a stressful moment like a lost card or a charge they don't recognize. Your job is to guide them, protect their account, and get them back on solid ground.
Healthcare Program — $14–$20 per hour plus incentives + $200 certification bonus
Compassionate, detail-oriented agents support a healthcare campaign, where your role is vital in providing clear information and support.
What you'll do:
- Engage with customers to understand their concerns and provide solutions
- Clearly explain the breach details and the services offered to them
- Maintain a high level of empathy and professionalism in all communications
- Accurately submit CRM tickets to ensure effective issue resolution
What Makes You a Fit (all programs)
- Communication: you connect over the phone, listen well, and stay empathetic even when the caller isn't calm
- Security and accuracy: you take protecting sensitive information seriously
- Tech comfort: you can move between multiple systems and databases at once
- Composure: you think clearly and solve problems in a fast-paced environment
- Remote customer service or contact center experience is a strong plus; 3+ years of customer service experience preferred
What You'll Need (all programs)
- Modern computer, USB headset, and reliable hard-wired internet connection (25 Mbps minimum)
- A quiet, professional home workspace suitable for customer calls
- Ability to complete program-specific qualifications, certifications, and onboarding
Independent Contractor Disclosure: ShyftOff provides opportunities for independent contractors, not traditional employment. Agents choose whether to accept available opportunities and are responsible for their own taxes, equipment, and business expenses. Compensation, qualifications, and available hours vary by program and are not guaranteed.

jobs.title: Internal Communications Specialist (18 month FTC)
jobs.summary: About us GoCardless, a Mollie company, is a global leader in bank payments. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send b…
jobs.description:
About us

GoCardless, a Mollie company, is a global leader in bank payments. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.

We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. For more information, please visit www.gocardless.com and follow us on LinkedIn @GoCardless.

Mollie is the leading payments and financial services partner for business, rooted in Europe, with global reach.

About the team

The Internal Communications team exists to:

-
Drive alignment to the company vision and strategy, so every employee has a clear understanding of our priorities, why they're important, and how their work impacts our success

-
Build trust and connection, so employees are engaged as true advocates of the business; feel they have a clear voice and are listened to; and are equipped to deliver outstanding work through periods of transformational change, including the integration of Mollie and GoCardless

-
Scale and iterate on our fantastic culture, so the combination of Mollie and GoCardless creates an irresistible place to work, with a strong sense of belonging.

What excites you:

-
Help lead the day-to-day planning and output of the Internal Comms team; this includes ensuring we execute against projects, whilst keeping the momentum going with our continuous 'drumbeat' of regular communications

-
Develop communication plans to support the GoCardless and Mollie integration, helping colleagues across both businesses understand what's changing, why it matters, and what it means for them; building confidence as we come together

-
Be the primary owner of our Town Hall sessions, from shaping the agenda and briefing leaders and speakers to producing content, delivering the sessions and creating and sharing follow-up materials, so each one helps employees across the business understand where we're heading, and why

-
Devise and execute communication plans (for example, to roll out our engagement survey, business transformation, or to celebrate the launch of a new product) which deliver clear, measurable outcomes

-
Build connections to become a trusted adviser to stakeholders around the business to advise them on achieving their communications goals

-
Co-manage our communications channels, including our intranet, Slack, and email tool, and help shape how these channels continually develop and help us to show up across both GoCardless and Mollie

-
Host and measure regular listening sessions with employees from all of our locations, including colleagues joining us through Mollie, to help inform our work and identify opportunities for improvement and impact.

What excites us:

There's endless opportunity to have an impact in this role. The team sits at the heart of the business, helping to curate, contextualise, and build a shared understanding of the business' priorities, and the progress we're making. This is particularly important as we continue to integrate Mollie and GoCardless.

We distribute engaging company information and drive change via the right audiences, at the right time, using the most relevant channels. The integration is a huge opportunity for our team, meaning this is a demanding but very fulfilling time to join us. You should have demonstrable prior experience in internal communications at a fast-paced organisation where you've been able to prioritise effectively to deliver communications of a consistently high standard. You should be proactive, ultimately keeping your 'finger on the pulse' of the business to identify opportunities for internal comms to strengthen execution against our mission.

Specifically:

-
Experience in a busy internal communications team or function

-
Ability to originate and execute strategic internal communications plans; tactically deliver them; and measure results

-
Experience taking the lead on internal communications aligned to various business transformation projects, with involvement 'end to end'; experience of M&A or integration communications is a real plus

-
Confidently build relationships with stakeholders (at all levels), and other employees, so they trust us as experts

-
Exceptional writing ability; you're unfazed by jargon and can easily transform complexity into something compelling and easy to understand, all in our authoritative and friendly tone of voice

-
An omnichannel mindset; you know how to get the very best out of various channels and platforms, from straightforward emails through to Slack, Zoom, face to face, intranet and more; you're keen to explore new technologies that enhance what we do - such as AI

-
You excel at, and are unfazed by, being 'hands on' to get things done, often having to prioritise multiple tasks at once. As a small team, we all chip in to deliver collective results

-
Ideally, experience handling logistics and communications for large company events, before, during and after.

Base salary range: € 2060 - € 3100 (gross)

Base salary ranges are based on role, job level, location, and market data. Please note that whilst we strive to offer competitive compensation, our approach is to pay between the minimum and the mid-point (€2060 - €2580 (gross)) of the pay range until performance can be assessed in the role. Offers will take into account level of experience, interview assessment, budgets and parity between you and fellow employees at GoCardless doing similar work.
(some of) The good stuff

- Wellbeing - stay healthy with dedicated support and medical cover

- Lunch- based on the location, you either get a meal voucher or a paid lunch when working from the office

- Work away scheme - gives you the option to work away from your country of residence for up to 20 working days in any 12-month period

- Adaptive Working - allows you to work flexibly, around your lifestyle

- Parental leave - to suit everyone embarking on life's great adventure

- Learning Budget - lead your own development with an annual learning budget

- Time off - generous holiday allowance + volunteer days for ERG events + one day off if you need to move house

Life at GoCardless

We're an organisation defined by our values; We start with why before we begin any project, to ensure it’s aligned with our mission. We make it happen, working with urgency and taking personal accountability for getting things done. We act with integrity, always. We care deeply about what we do and we know it's essential that we be humble whilst we do it. Our Values form part of the GoCardless DNA, and are used to not only help us nurture and develop our culture, but to deliver impactful work that will help us to achieve our vision.

Diversity & Inclusion

As of April 2025, we had 806 employees (GeeCees) globally, with 524 based in the UK, 163 based in Latvia and 119 across our other offices.

To ensure that we're representative of the world around us - and to be able to review relevant benchmarks - we ask GeeCees to voluntarily disclose diversity data. This year, the proportion of GeeCees providing data increased to 88% (up from 79% in 2024). With regards to diversity within GoCardless, we can see GeeCees identifying as:

Asian, Black, Mixed or Other — 25%

Neurodiverse — 9%

LGBTQIA+ — 9%

Disabled — 1%

Average age — 33

Female — 45%

Male — 55%

We’re rooting for you during your application and GoCardless aims to provide reasonable adjustments to make our recruitment process as remarkable and accessible as we can. Please speak to your Talent Partner if you need extra support.

If you want to learn more, you can read about our Employee Resource Groups and objectives here

Sustainability

We’re committed to reducing our impact on the environment, leaving a more sustainable world for future generations. Check out our sustainability action plan here.

Find out more about Life at GoCardless via Twitter, Instagram and LinkedIn.

jobs.title: Paid Media Specialist - Argentina (Hybrid)
jobs.summary: Clara is the leading platform in Latin America for companies to execute and manage every payment operation.
jobs.description:
Clara is the leading platform in Latin America for companies to execute and manage every payment operation. More than 50,000 leading and fast-growing businesses run on our corporate cards, bill pay, financing and B2B payments, and in 2025 the Financial Times named Clara the region’s fastest-growing company. We’re passionate about helping every company we work with become more effective—and, through that, raising the region’s competitiveness. We’re ~400 people, backed by Notable Capital, Coatue, Kaszek, monashees, DST Global, ICONIQ, General Catalyst and Goldman Sachs, among others.

What you'll do

This is a highly hands-on Paid Media role. You will work directly inside the advertising platforms every day—building and launching campaigns, uploading creatives and copy, checking tracking, monitoring performance, and making optimizations.
This is not a strategy-only, coordination, or people-management position. We’re looking for someone who enjoys executing the work themselves and taking direct ownership of campaigns from setup through ongoing optimization.
You’ll manage campaigns across multiple platforms and markets while using AI as a core part of your workflow. You’ll be operating within one of Latin America’s fastest-growing companies, as ranked by the Financial Times, on a team that is actively building AI-native workflows into everything we do.
Your work will directly impact how Clara grows across Mexico, Brazil, and Colombia—and you’ll help define what AI-augmented Paid Media execution looks like at scale

Your responsibilities will include:

- Launch, monitor and quality assurance of campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and other platforms.

- Set up tracking and attribution according to internal guidelines — including AI-assisted tagging validation and anomaly detection.

- Use AI tools daily to accelerate campaign work: generating ad copy variants, summarizing performance data, building audience hypotheses, and drafting creative briefs.

- Conduct keyword and audience research using both native platform tools and AI-powered research assistants (e.g. Claude, Perplexity, ChatGPT, custom GPTs).

- Support in A/B tests and make regular optimizations — using AI to generate hypotheses, interpret results, and suggest next steps.

- Experience collaborating with creative teams — including using AI to brief or iterate on creative assets.

Why Clara
